questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY

questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY
questions.learningObjective: examine foraging societies using anthropological evidence

stimulus.body: Small mobile groups move camp to follow seasonal plant and animal resources and share food widely within the band.

questions.stem: The evidence most strongly supports which claim about foraging societies?

questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY
